name: discover
description: Takes a student from a vague idea, or only an area of interest, to a checked evidence report and a plan to interview real people. It never judges the idea: real people give the verdict and the student makes every call. Session 1 of the AI Build Lab for Founders series at the Berkley Center for Entrepreneurship. Part of Leverage by BCE. Designed and built by Nayan Kanaparthi.

author.name: Nayan Kanaparthi, Berkley Center for Entrepreneurship, NYU Stern
